messages:
alex: Hey folks — I have a calendar conflict and need to swap my ARB slot next Wed 2:00pm. Can someone host the session? I was planning a compact 30m: three quick RFC reviews + a 5m triage overflow. If you can take it, say so and I’ll update the invite and handoff notes. @tara @sam :raised_hands:

tara: I can host if we keep it to 30m. Need slides from presenters by EOD Mon so I can prep. Also prefer to run a strict timer for each RFC. :timer_clock:

sam: I’m out that afternoon, sorry. Can I swap one of my 10m slots earlier to Friday so a different RFC presenter can swap in?

jen: I can cover hosting if tara’s busy — but I’ll need the deploy demo to be limited to 3 mins. Otherwise happy to do the canary/fallback review. :+1:

kevin: Quick Q — are we doing the usual pre-read links in the invite or a short TL;DR in the first 2 minutes? Pre-reads help me triage better.

alex: Good call. Let’s keep pre-reads in the invite and one-slide TL;DR in the first minute of each RFC. I’ll add a small pre-read checklist in the invite.

alex: Agenda draft (copy/paste into invite):
```
1) 2:00 — 2:02: Host intro + TL;DR workflow (host)
2) 2:02 — 2:12: RFC A — shard placement policy (presenter + 3m TL;DR, 7m discussion)
3) 2:12 — 2:22: RFC B — KV cache eviction changes (presenter + 3m TL;DR, 7m discussion)
4) 2:22 — 2:27: RFC C — health-check semantics (presenter + 2m TL;DR, 3m discussion)
5) 2:27 — 2:30: Triage & action items (host)
```

alex: Presenter deliverables: add pre-read link in the invite, upload 1-slide TL;DR to the thread by Mon EOD, and list the rollout plan + any rollback signals.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar slot locked for 2pm PT next Wed. If you change host, update the organizer field so access controls transfer.

tara: I’ll take it. Marking myself as host and will ping presenters for slides. If anyone else wants to swap a presenter slot, DM me. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I’ll pre-read RFC B and post comments in-thread by Tue afternoon. If anything looks high-risk I’ll flag for a short follow-up.

jen: Thanks @tara — I’ll shorten the demo and upload the one-pager by Mon.

alex: Awesome — finalizing. Tara will host; I’ve updated the invite assignee and added the agenda + pre-read checklist. Thanks y’all. :rocket:
